name: sim_weyl_g2_exceptional_emergence
description: G2 is exceptional: triple bond (A21=-3) unique among rank-2 algebras; 12 roots (6 short + 6 long) generated and closure verified; G2 cannot decompose as A2×A1 (UNSAT — long roots span R^2); Clifford grade-0 recovers A21=-3; W(G2)=D6 order 12; Coxeter h=6

pytorch.reason: Build G2 root system (12 roots) via Weyl reflections starting from two simple roots; verify all 12 roots generated and system is closed; verify G2 roots cannot be partitioned into A2 subset + A1 subset forming an orthogonal direct product (no classical decomposition)

pyg.reason: not used in G2 exceptional emergence probe; graph via rustworkx

z3.reason: UNSAT: G2 root system decomposes as A2×A1 — impossible since G2 is simple (Lie algebra irreducible); z3 encodes the A2 subset (6 long roots) and checks whether the remaining 6 short roots form a mutually orthogonal A1-type system; they do not (they are NOT pairwise orthogonal)

cvc5.reason: z3 sufficient for irreducibility UNSAT; cvc5 deferred

sympy.reason: G2 Cartan matrix [[2,-1],[-3,2]] has off-diagonal product 3 — unique among rank-2 algebras; prove that no classical series A/B/C/D can have a triple-bond Dynkin diagram; verify G2 dimension = 14 symbolically

clifford.reason: G2 roots in Cl(2,0); rotor between simple roots alpha1 and alpha2 has grade-0 scalar component = alpha1·alpha2; for G2 this scalar encodes the triple bond via A21*A12=3; grade-2 component encodes the 150-degree angle between simple roots

geomstats.reason: no Riemannian manifold computation required; geometry handled analytically

e3nn.reason: no SO(3)-equivariant neural network computation required in this probe

rustworkx.reason: G2 Dynkin diagram: 2-node graph with edge weight 3 (triple bond); all classical rank-2 Dynkin diagrams have edge weight ≤ 2; verify G2 is the unique rank-2 diagram with weight 3

xgi.reason: 3-way hyperedge {alpha1_short, alpha2_long, Coxeter_order_6} encodes the irreducibly triadic nature of G2: the two simple roots plus the Coxeter number 6 are jointly needed to characterize G2 exceptionality; no 2-way link suffices

toponetx.reason: no chain complex or cell complex computation required in this probe

gudhi.reason: no persistent homology or Rips complex computation required in this probe

z3_g2_not_classical_a21.claim: A21=-3 AND A12<0 (connected) AND product≤2 (classical bound)
z3_g2_not_classical_a21.explanation: A21=-3, A12<0 forces (-3)*A12 ≥ 3 > 2; classical bound says A21*A12 ≤ 2; these are jointly unsatisfiable => G2 is not classical; UNSAT

z3_g2_product_not_1.claim: G2 off-diagonal product = 1 (A2-type) with A21=-3, A12=-1
z3_g2_product_not_1.explanation: (-3)*(-1) = 3 ≠ 1; asserting product=1 with G2 entries is arithmetic contradiction; UNSAT

xgi_g2_exceptional_hyperedge.note: Coxeter order 6 is the order of s1*s2 in W(G2); confirms G2 identity
